info.title: API.SH: Flipkart
info.description: The Flipkart API from API.SH: public Flipkart data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A category or browse listing on Flipkart (India): the products of a category page with title, price, MRP, discount, rating, ratings and reviews counts, stock, Flipkart Assured flag, key specs and images, with the category's sort options and breadcrumbs. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page (Flipkart shows at most 25 pages). Filter with `brand`, `rating_min`, `discount_min`, `assured`, `in_stock` and `filters`; `facets` lists every filter of the page with its values, counts and the `filter` string to pass back.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flipkart-category

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A flipkart.com category page URL, e.g. `https://www.flipkart.com/mobiles/pr?sid=tyy,4io` (`sid` works in place of `url`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: price_asc / price_desc: by price; recency_desc: newest first.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price, whole rupees (INR).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price, whole rupees (INR).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand names to keep, comma-separated, e.g. `Samsung,Apple`.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: `4` (4 stars and above) or `3` (3 stars and above).

parameters.name: discount_min
parameters.description: Lowest discount in percent: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 … 90.

parameters.name: assured
parameters.description: `true`: Flipkart Assured products only.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: `true`: leave out products that are out of stock.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any other filters of the page, as listed in `facets[].values[].filter`, e.g. `facets.ram[]=8 GB and Above`; several separated by `;`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every seller offering a Flipkart product at a delivery PIN code (the site's other-sellers list): listing id, whether it is the featured offer, price, MRP, discount, seller (id, name, rating, new seller), delivery text, date and charge, free delivery, cash on delivery, Flipkart Assured, return policy, fulfilment, maximum quantity, country of origin, payment modes and the bank and partner offers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flipkart-offers

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A flipkart.com product link (or a share link), or the product id in `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id (pid), e.g. MOBHQV9YZGYG64U7.

parameters.name: pincode
parameters.description: Delivery PIN code (default 560001).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Customer reviews of a Flipkart product, 10 per page: title, text, rating, author, location, certified-buyer flag, helpful / unhelpful votes, the variant bought and photos, plus the rating summary. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flipkart-reviews

get.description:
A Flipkart seller's card as product pages show it: name, seller score, product quality and service quality scores with what they measure, time on Flipkart and the seller's note. Take `seller_id` and the product from /flipkart/v1/offers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flipkart-seller

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Seller id (offers[].seller.id in /flipkart/v1/offers).

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: A product the seller offers (id or product link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
